From Fuzzy to Exact: The Halo Architecture for Infinite-Depth Reasoning via Rational Arithmetic

Hansheng Ren Affiliation: Independent Researcher
iamhanshr@gmail.com
Abstract

Current paradigms in Deep Learning prioritize computational throughput over numerical precision, relying on the assumption that intelligence emerges from statistical correlation at scale. In this paper, we challenge this orthodoxy. We propose the Exactness Hypothesis: that General Intelligence (AGI), specifically high-order causal inference, requires a computational substrate capable of Arbitrary Precision Arithmetic. We argue that the “hallucinations” and logical incoherence seen in current Large Language Models (LLMs) are artifacts of IEEE 754 floating-point approximation errors accumulating over deep compositional functions. To mitigate this, we introduce the Halo Architecture, a paradigm shift to Rational Arithmetic (ℚ\mathbb{Q}) supported by a novel Exact Inference Unit (EIU). Empirical validation on the Huginn-0125 prototype demonstrates that while 600B-parameter scale BF16 baselines collapse in chaotic systems, Halo maintains zero numerical divergence indefinitely. This work establishes exact arithmetic as a prerequisite for reducing logical uncertainty in System 2 AGI.

1 Introduction

The “Scaling Laws” of Large Language Models (LLMs) have driven the industry towards lower-precision formats (FP16, BF16, and recently FP8) to maximize matrix multiplication throughput (Kaplan et al., 2020). While effective for intuitive pattern matching, this strategy shows diminishing returns for tasks involving multi-step reasoning, symbolic manipulation, and long-horizon planning. We argue that this is due to a fundamental mismatch between the physical substrate (approximate floating-point hardware) and the mathematical requirements of rigorous logic. Logic is discrete and precise; floating-point arithmetic is continuous and approximate. We observe that in deep recursive inference, numerical noise ϵ\epsilon accumulates exponentially (𝒪⁡(eL)\mathcal{O}(e^{L})), eventually drowning out the causal signal. We term this phenomenon Semantic Drift. This aligns with recent findings by Thinking Machines Lab (Thinking Machines Lab, 2025), who pinpointed floating-point non-associativity as the culprit for inference instability. In this work, we propose the Halo Architecture, which moves from the approximate field of real numbers (ℝ\mathbb{R}) to the exact field of rational numbers (ℚ\mathbb{Q}). We ensure that operations such as 1/3+1/3+1/31/3+1/3+1/3 yield exactly 11, rather than 0.99999990.9999999.

2 Related Work

Numerical Stability in Deep Learning. The fragility of floating-point arithmetic in recursive systems is well-documented in dynamical systems theory (Lozej and Robnik, 2021). Recent work by Thinking Machines Lab (2025) highlighted non-associativity as a source of inference non-determinism. While techniques like Quantization Aware Training (QAT) (Jacob et al., 2018) attempt to make models robust to low precision, they treat noise as a constraint to be managed. Halo departs from this by treating noise as an error to be eliminated, shifting the paradigm from "Robust Approximation" to "Exact Computation."

Information Bottleneck & Discrete Representation. The "Ring" mechanism draws theoretical grounding from the Information Bottleneck (IB) principle (Tishby et al., 2000). By periodically collapsing the continuous rational stream into a low-complexity codebook, we explicitly filter out "nuisance variables" (high-frequency numerical noise) while preserving "relevant variables" (logical structure). This aligns with Vector Quantized VAEs (VQ-VAE) (Van Den Oord et al., 2017), but whereas VQ-VAE learns a codebook for compression, Halo uses the axiomatic field ℚ\mathbb{Q} as a "Universal Codebook" for logical grounding.

Recurrent Depth Models (The Huginn Architecture)

Our work builds directly upon the Huginn-0125 prototype, which first proposed scaling "test-time compute" via recurrent latent reasoning loops. While Huginn demonstrated the architectural viability of decoupling parameter count from reasoning depth, it relied on standard BF16 arithmetic. Consequently, Huginn models suffered from state collapse (divergence) after approximately 50 recurrent steps. Halo can be viewed as the necessary numerical substrate that enables the Huginn architecture to fulfill its theoretical promise of infinite-depth reasoning.

Hallucination as a Numerical Artifact

The prevailing view attributes LLM hallucinations to data contamination or probabilistic decoding errors (Ji et al., 2023). We propose an alternative, complementary hypothesis: that a significant subset of "logical hallucinations" (e.g., arithmetic errors, causal inconsistencies) are artifacts of Numerical Uncertainty. In chaotic systems, microscopic floating-point errors (ϵ\epsilon) amplify exponentially over time (Lozej and Robnik, 2021), causing the model’s internal state to drift off the logical manifold. Halo eliminates this source of error, suggesting that exactness is a prerequisite for faithfulness.

Floating-Point Instability

The peril of floating-point arithmetic is well-documented in scientific computing (Goldberg, 1991; Higham, 2002), yet largely ignored in modern LLM training. While low-precision formats (FP8, BF16) suffice for statistical pattern matching (Micikevicius et al., 2018), dynamical systems theory suggests that deep recurrent architectures operate near the "edge of chaos". Halo solves this by shifting the arithmetic substrate from ℝ\mathbb{R} to ℚ\mathbb{Q}.

Neuro-Symbolic AI & Neural Arithmetic

Halo shares the goal of Neuro-Symbolic AI (Mao et al., 2019) but rejects the separation of "Neural" and "Symbolic" modules. Instead, we internalize exactness into the weights themselves. Similarly, unlike NALU (Trask et al., 2018) which attempted arithmetic via gating in float space, Halo achieves true arithmetic capability by adopting a rational number system.

3 The Exactness Hypothesis

Just as the Scaling Hypothesis (Kaplan et al., 2020) posits that performance scales with compute, our Exactness Hypothesis posits that reasoning depth scales with numerical precision.

3.3 Theoretical Proof: The Non-Associativity of Floats

A critical flaw in floating-point arithmetic is the violation of associativity. In IEEE 754 arithmetic, (a+b)+c≠a+(b+c)(a+b)+c\neq a+(b+c). This phenomenon has recently been identified by Thinking Machines Lab (2025) as the primary source of non-determinism in LLM inference, causing "run-to-run" variations even at zero temperature. They demonstrated that parallel reduction orders in GPUs introduce noise that alters generation trajectories. We argue that this issue extends beyond mere reproducibility. In deep reasoning chains, this non-determinism acts as an implicit, uncontrolled noise injection. Consider a distributed training setup reducing gradients from 3 GPUs (g1,g2,g3g_{1},g_{2},g_{3}). 4 The Halo Architecture

4.1 Algorithmic Formulation

The Halo architecture unifies infinite-precision arithmetic with recurrent semantic grounding. Algorithm 1 details the end-to-end inference process, strictly distinguishing between the “Light” stream (Rational ℚ\mathbb{Q}) and the “Ring” mechanism (Float ℝ\mathbb{R}).

4.2 The Light: Infinite Precision Stream

“The Light” represents the unattenuated flow of information. We define the computational medium as a stream of exact fractions p/qp/q. Unlike floating-point numbers which drift, “The Light” ensures that the inference depth is limited only by time, not by precision loss.

4.3 The Ring: Vector-Symbolic Collapsing

To manage the potential complexity growth of rational numbers, we introduce The Ring. At every NN-th cycle in the recurrent loop, the continuous vector vv is forced to collapse into discrete symbols (Language), verified for logical consistency, and then re-embedded.

This process resets the semantic entropy to zero, acting as a logical anchor. The Ring mechanism can be viewed through the lens of the Information Bottleneck principle (Tishby et al., 2000): by collapsing the state to a finite set of rationals, we explicitly filter out the “nuisance variables” (numerical noise) while retaining the “relevant variables” (logical structure).

4.4 Implementation: The Exact Inference Unit

Current GPUs are optimized for “Fuzzy Computing.” The Halo Architecture relies on a new class of hardware, the Exact Inference Unit (EIU), featuring:

    Native Rational Arithmetic: Hardware support for storing numbers as integer pairs (n,d)(n,d), avoiding rounding errors entirely.

  2. 2.

    Dynamic Bit-width: Registers that expand dynamically to accommodate the necessary precision for zero-loss calculation.

  3. 3.

    Deterministic Parallelism: Guaranteeing that (A+B)+C=A+(B+C)(A+B)+C=A+(B+C). This associativity property is lost in parallel floating-point reduction Goldberg (1991) but is essential for consistent logical reasoning.

6 Discussion

6.1 Numerical Noise as Aleatoric Uncertainty

In Bayesian terms, floating-point truncation acts as a persistent source of aleatoric uncertainty (σn​o​i​s​e\sigma_{noise}). In standard Transformers, this noise is propagated and amplified by non-linearities, transforming into epistemic uncertainty (model hallucination). The Halo Architecture effectively sets σn​o​i​s​e=0\sigma_{noise}=0, ensuring that remaining uncertainty is purely data-driven.

6.2 Theoretical Implications: Why Exactness is Non-Negotiable

Our experiments suggest that the advantage of Halo is not merely quantitative (lower error) but qualitative (structural stability). We articulate this through three theoretical lenses:

1. The Irreversibility of Chaos

Deep neural networks operate as chaotic dynamical systems. A microscopic floating-point error ϵ\epsilon at the input layer is amplified by non-linearities (ReLU, Attention) over depth LL, growing as ϵ​eλ​L\epsilon e^{\lambda L} (where λ>0\lambda>0 is the Lyapunov exponent). In ℝ\mathbb{R} (floats), this divergence is thermodynamically irreversible—the model loses the “fingerprint” of the original information, making error correction mathematically impossible. In contrast, Rational Arithmetic over ℚ\mathbb{Q} is exact and reversible. Even at step T=1000T=1000, the state retains perfect fidelity to the initial conditions, allowing the model to trace causal chains without information loss.

2. Butterfly Effect vs. Logical Rigidity

Consider a symbolic reasoning chain: A→B→CA\to B\to C. In BF16, “Semantic Drift” causes the vector representation of state BB to migrate. At step 50, a drift of δ=10−3\delta=10^{-3} may push the vector from the manifold of concept BB into an ambiguous region (e.g., a superposition of BB and DD). This discontinuity breaks the reasoning chain, manifesting as hallucination. Halo enforces “Logical Rigidity”: the value 1/31/3 remains exactly 1/31/3 indefinitely. This acts as a “Quantum Lock” on semantics, preventing the vector from drifting into invalid states and ensuring that long-horizon deductions remain grounded.

3. The Purity of Optimization

Standard LLMs suffer from a “Dual Optimization Burden”: they must simultaneously learn (1) the underlying logical laws of the data, and (2) heuristic robustness against intrinsic floating-point noise. This effectively wastes parameter capacity on denoising rather than reasoning. By eliminating arithmetic noise at the substrate level, Halo enables Pure Optimization: the entire parameter budget is dedicated to learning causal logic. Consequently, a Halo model possesses a strictly higher “Effective Intelligence Quotient” (Effective IQ) than a BF16 model of equivalent parameter count.

6.3 The Ultimate Frontier: Towards a Universal Cure

Our ambition extends beyond specific pathologies to the grandest challenge of all: solving disease itself. Whether it is the stochastic mutation of a cancer cell, the folding trajectory of an Alzheimer’s plaque, or the evasion mechanics of a novel virus, all diseases operate as state transitions within a hyper-complex dynamical system. Current AI fails to "solve" these not due to a lack of data, but due to a lack of Causal Precision. A floating-point model simulating a cell for 10610^{6} steps drifts into biological nonsense, rendering long-term "In Silico Trials" impossible. Halo offers the computational substrate for a Universal Biological Simulator. By enforcing exact conservation of mass and energy in every metabolic step, Halo transforms biology from an approximate descriptive science into a precise predictive engineering discipline. We posit that the cure for "all diseases" lies hidden in the deep causal chains of our biology, and only an infinite-depth, zero-error reasoning engine can excavate them.

Halo’s Rational Arithmetic acts as a Symplectic Integrator, perfectly preserving physical invariants. This allows the model to explore the chemical space of 106010^{60} molecules without being misled by numerical artifacts, effectively enabling the "compilation" of matter from code.

We call for a divergence in research: while one path pursues scale, the other must pursue Exactness.

Abstract
Current paradigms in Deep Learning prioritize computational throughput over numerical precision, relying on the assumption that intelligence emerges from statistical correlation at scale.
In this paper, we challenge this orthodoxy. We propose the Exactness Hypothesis : that General Intelligence (AGI), specifically high-order causal inference, requires a computational substrate capable of Arbitrary Precision Arithmetic.
We argue that the “hallucinations” and logical incoherence seen in current Large Language Models (LLMs) are artifacts of IEEE 754 floating-point approximation errors accumulating over deep compositional functions.
To mitigate this, we introduce the Halo Architecture , a paradigm shift to Rational Arithmetic ( ℚ \mathbb{Q} ) supported by a novel Exact Inference Unit (EIU).
Empirical validation on the Huginn-0125 prototype demonstrates that while 600B-parameter scale BF16 baselines collapse in chaotic systems, Halo maintains zero numerical divergence indefinitely.
This work establishes exact arithmetic as a prerequisite for reducing logical uncertainty in System 2 AGI.
1 Introduction
The “Scaling Laws” of Large Language Models (LLMs) have driven the industry towards lower-precision formats (FP16, BF16, and recently FP8) to maximize matrix multiplication throughput ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ) .
While effective for intuitive pattern matching, this strategy shows diminishing returns for tasks involving multi-step reasoning, symbolic manipulation, and long-horizon planning.
We argue that this is due to a fundamental mismatch between the physical substrate (approximate floating-point hardware) and the mathematical requirements of rigorous logic.
Logic is discrete and precise; floating-point arithmetic is continuous and approximate.
We observe that in deep recursive inference, numerical noise ϵ \epsilon accumulates exponentially ( 𝒪 ⁡ ( e L ) \mathcal{O}(e^{L}) ), eventually drowning out the causal signal.
We term this phenomenon Semantic Drift . This aligns with recent findings by Thinking Machines Lab ( Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ) , who pinpointed floating-point non-associativity as the culprit for inference instability.
In this work, we propose the Halo Architecture , which moves from the approximate field of real numbers ( ℝ \mathbb{R} ) to the exact field of rational numbers ( ℚ \mathbb{Q} ).
We ensure that operations such as 1 / 3 + 1 / 3 + 1 / 3 1/3+1/3+1/3 yield exactly 1 1 , rather than 0.9999999 0.9999999 .
2 Related Work
Numerical Stability in Deep Learning.
The fragility of floating-point arithmetic in recursive systems is well-documented in dynamical systems theory ( Lozej and Robnik, 2021 ) .
Recent work by Thinking Machines Lab (2025) highlighted non-associativity as a source of inference non-determinism.
While techniques like Quantization Aware Training (QAT) ( Jacob et al., 2018 ) attempt to make models robust to low precision, they treat noise as a constraint to be managed.
Halo departs from this by treating noise as an error to be eliminated, shifting the paradigm from "Robust Approximation" to "Exact Computation."
Information Bottleneck & Discrete Representation.
The "Ring" mechanism draws theoretical grounding from the Information Bottleneck (IB) principle ( Tishby et al., 2000 ) .
By periodically collapsing the continuous rational stream into a low-complexity codebook, we explicitly filter out "nuisance variables" (high-frequency numerical noise) while preserving "relevant variables" (logical structure).
This aligns with Vector Quantized VAEs (VQ-VAE) ( Van Den Oord et al., 2017 ) , but whereas VQ-VAE learns a codebook for compression, Halo uses the axiomatic field ℚ \mathbb{Q} as a "Universal Codebook" for logical grounding.
Recurrent Depth Models (The Huginn Architecture)
Our work builds directly upon the Huginn-0125 prototype, which first proposed scaling "test-time compute" via recurrent latent reasoning loops.
While Huginn demonstrated the architectural viability of decoupling parameter count from reasoning depth, it relied on standard BF16 arithmetic.
Consequently, Huginn models suffered from state collapse (divergence) after approximately 50 recurrent steps.
Halo can be viewed as the necessary numerical substrate that enables the Huginn architecture to fulfill its theoretical promise of infinite-depth reasoning.
Hallucination as a Numerical Artifact
The prevailing view attributes LLM hallucinations to data contamination or probabilistic decoding errors ( Ji et al., 2023 ) .
We propose an alternative, complementary hypothesis: that a significant subset of "logical hallucinations" (e.g., arithmetic errors, causal inconsistencies) are artifacts of Numerical Uncertainty .
In chaotic systems, microscopic floating-point errors ( ϵ \epsilon ) amplify exponentially over time ( Lozej and Robnik, 2021 ) , causing the model’s internal state to drift off the logical manifold.
Halo eliminates this source of error, suggesting that exactness is a prerequisite for faithfulness.
Floating-Point Instability
The peril of floating-point arithmetic is well-documented in scientific computing ( Goldberg, 1991 ; Higham, 2002 ) , yet largely ignored in modern LLM training.
While low-precision formats (FP8, BF16) suffice for statistical pattern matching ( Micikevicius et al., 2018 ) , dynamical systems theory suggests that deep recurrent architectures operate near the "edge of chaos".
Halo solves this by shifting the arithmetic substrate from ℝ \mathbb{R} to ℚ \mathbb{Q} .
Neuro-Symbolic AI & Neural Arithmetic
Halo shares the goal of Neuro-Symbolic AI ( Mao et al., 2019 ) but rejects the separation of "Neural" and "Symbolic" modules.
Instead, we internalize exactness into the weights themselves. Similarly, unlike NALU ( Trask et al., 2018 ) which attempted arithmetic via gating in float space, Halo achieves true arithmetic capability by adopting a rational number system.
3 The Exactness Hypothesis
Just as the Scaling Hypothesis ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ) posits that performance scales with compute, our Exactness Hypothesis posits that reasoning depth scales with numerical precision.

3.3 Theoretical Proof: The Non-Associativity of Floats

6.1 Numerical Noise as Aleatoric Uncertainty
In Bayesian terms, floating-point truncation acts as a persistent source of aleatoric uncertainty ( σ n ​ o ​ i ​ s ​ e \sigma_{noise} ).
In standard Transformers, this noise is propagated and amplified by non-linearities, transforming into epistemic uncertainty (model hallucination).
The Halo Architecture effectively sets σ n ​ o ​ i ​ s ​ e = 0 \sigma_{noise}=0 , ensuring that remaining uncertainty is purely data-driven.
6.2 Theoretical Implications: Why Exactness is Non-Negotiable
Our experiments suggest that the advantage of Halo is not merely quantitative (lower error) but qualitative (structural stability).
We articulate this through three theoretical lenses:
1. The Irreversibility of Chaos
Deep neural networks operate as chaotic dynamical systems.
A microscopic floating-point error ϵ \epsilon at the input layer is amplified by non-linearities (ReLU, Attention) over depth L L , growing as ϵ ​ e λ ​ L \epsilon e^{\lambda L} (where λ > 0 \lambda>0 is the Lyapunov exponent).
In ℝ \mathbb{R} (floats), this divergence is thermodynamically irreversible —the model loses the “fingerprint” of the original information, making error correction mathematically impossible.
In contrast, Rational Arithmetic over ℚ \mathbb{Q} is exact and reversible .
Even at step T = 1000 T=1000 , the state retains perfect fidelity to the initial conditions, allowing the model to trace causal chains without information loss.
2. Butterfly Effect vs. Logical Rigidity
Consider a symbolic reasoning chain: A → B → C A\to B\to C .
In BF16, “Semantic Drift” causes the vector representation of state B B to migrate.
At step 50, a drift of δ = 10 − 3 \delta=10^{-3} may push the vector from the manifold of concept B B into an ambiguous region (e.g., a superposition of B B and D D ).
This discontinuity breaks the reasoning chain, manifesting as hallucination. Halo enforces “Logical Rigidity” : the value 1 / 3 1/3 remains exactly 1 / 3 1/3 indefinitely.
This acts as a “Quantum Lock” on semantics, preventing the vector from drifting into invalid states and ensuring that long-horizon deductions remain grounded.
3. The Purity of Optimization
Standard LLMs suffer from a “Dual Optimization Burden” : they must simultaneously learn (1) the underlying logical laws of the data, and (2) heuristic robustness against intrinsic floating-point noise.
This effectively wastes parameter capacity on denoising rather than reasoning.
By eliminating arithmetic noise at the substrate level, Halo enables Pure Optimization : the entire parameter budget is dedicated to learning causal logic.
Consequently, a Halo model possesses a strictly higher “Effective Intelligence Quotient” (Effective IQ) than a BF16 model of equivalent parameter count.
6.3 The Ultimate Frontier: Towards a Universal Cure
Our ambition extends beyond specific pathologies to the grandest challenge of all: solving disease itself .
Whether it is the stochastic mutation of a cancer cell, the folding trajectory of an Alzheimer’s plaque, or the evasion mechanics of a novel virus, all diseases operate as state transitions within a hyper-complex dynamical system.
Current AI fails to "solve" these not due to a lack of data, but due to a lack of Causal Precision .
A floating-point model simulating a cell for 10 6 10^{6} steps drifts into biological nonsense, rendering long-term "In Silico Trials" impossible.
Halo offers the computational substrate for a Universal Biological Simulator .
By enforcing exact conservation of mass and energy in every metabolic step, Halo transforms biology from an approximate descriptive science into a precise predictive engineering discipline.
We posit that the cure for "all diseases" lies hidden in the deep causal chains of our biology, and only an infinite-depth, zero-error reasoning engine can excavate them.
Halo’s Rational Arithmetic acts as a Symplectic Integrator , perfectly preserving physical invariants.
This allows the model to explore the chemical space of 10 60 10^{60} molecules without being misled by numerical artifacts, effectively enabling the "compilation" of matter from code.
We call for a divergence in research: while one path pursues scale, the other must pursue Exactness .
